{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-knit jumper, slim fit, round neckline, long sleeves, hip length, dusty blue #8FB0CF, merino wool
A-line midi skirt, high waist, mid-calf length, deep navy #1F2A44, wool crepe
Tailored single-breasted jacket, hip length, softly structured shoulders, one-button closure, slate grey #4A5568, textured wool tweed
Sheer tights, matte finish, charcoal navy #2A2D3A, fine nylon knit
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, ink black #1C1C24, smooth leather
Small structured shoulder bag, top handle with a slim strap, ink black #1C1C24, smooth leather
Drop earrings, small and simple, pearl white #E8E6E1, freshwater pearl with silver-tone fittings
Light scarf, draped loosely at the neck, pearl grey #C9CDD4, fine wool-silk blend
Knee-length coat, straight cut with a notch collar, charcoal #3B3F4A, wool-cashmere blend

This outfit sits in the neat, classic register that suits an evening at the theatre: a refined knit with a skirt and a textured jacket, finished with low-heeled ankle boots that stay comfortable through a long performance. The dusty blue echoes her eye color and the cool grey tones pick up her silver hair, while the deep navy keeps everything calm and restrained. The high-waisted A-line skirt and the tailored jacket create a clean, balanced line. The coat is there because an autumn evening will be cool when she leaves after the show, and it comes off easily in the cloakroom."}
